name: Alt Magic: AI Powered Alt Texts
author: altmagic

sections.description:
Alt Magic Pro is an innovative WordPress plugin designed to automatically generate alt texts for images using advanced AI models. This plugin enhances accessibility and SEO optimization by ensuring that every image on your website has contextually relevant alt text.

Features:

– Auto-generate new alt text for any newly added image.
– Click to generate alt text for existing images.
– Bulk generate alt texts for multiple images.
– Automatically add captions, titles, and descriptions to images.
– All generated alt texts are contextually relevant.
– Integrates with popular SEO plugins like Yoast for keyword-rich alt texts.

Service Explanation:

Alt Magic Pro relies on API calls to our remote servers at https://alt-magic-api-eabaa2c8506a.herokuapp.com for generating alt texts using advanced AI models. Users need to create an account at Alt Magic Pro and obtain an API key to use this service. The services provided by the APIs are listed below:
– Verifying API key for connecting the account to WordPress site
– Generating alt text for the images
– Checking credits usage for the user account created on https://app.altmagic.pro
– Sending notifications to user whenever their accounts get empty and the automatic alt text generation stops

Data Handling:

The plugin sends image data to our servers for processing, which allows us to deliver accurate alt texts. The plugin also fetches credits data from the AltMagic account.
For more information, please refer to:
– Service Link
– Terms of Use
– Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Install the Alt Magic Pro from the Plugins directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to settings under the ‘Alt Magic Pro’ menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. You will be asked an API Key on this page
  5. Open https://app.altmagic.pro in a new tab and signup with your account
  6. Go to WordPress Plugin from the left navigation menu
  7. Click on “Generate API Key” button
  8. Copy the generated key and paste it in the settings page of the plugin and click on “Verify”
sections.faq:
How does Alt Magic Pro generate alt text?

Alt Magic Pro utilizes advanced AI models that analyze the content of images and the post content context to create descriptive and contextual alt texts.

Can I edit the generated alt texts?

Yes, all generated alt texts are editable. You can modify them as needed to better fit your content.

Is it compatible with other plugins?

Alt Magic Pro integrates smoothly with popular SEO plugins like Yoast, enhancing your website’s search engine optimization efforts.
